rca_of_issue: Prior iteration bug (iter 15/16): when the vision model read the card's NAME but couldn't confirm the collector NUMBER, the backend was still populating the CardInfo.name/set/number from JustTCG's `closest match` — which could be a completely different printing/card if the fuzzy match landed on the wrong candidate (e.g. Pikachu 58/102 in one set vs. Pikachu 58 in another set). User reported 'wrong card' shown. Fix (this iter): in the else branch of `if result:` in /api/scan-card, keep the JustTCG lookup for image/price CONFIDENCE but do NOT copy m.get('name/set_name/number/rarity') into the response. Instead trust `ident` (vision) fields and refuse to show a price. Verified via test_non_strict_trusts_vision_no_price with a doctored Pikachu image (bottom 14% blacked out): response now has name='Pikachu' from vision, price all None, price_source None, reasoning contains the exact user-facing warning.
